subject: OnRamp cohort credits — fulfillment & carry-forward ask
messages:
From: Sara Jones <sara@onramp.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partners@onramp.io
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OnRamp cohort support: promotional credit request

Hi Tessa / Aditya —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We have a Fall 2026 developer cohort starting Sep 20 and would love to include a Redwood onramp offering for 12 early-stage startups (approx 6 teams will run a short POC). Our ask: 100k promotional token credits to be split across the cohort (flexible allocation), plus a one-week trial extension for any teams that need extra ramp time.

Rationale: this cohort is run by OnRamp Partners and feeds into their marketplace listing; previous partners who provided a modest credits pool saw 2 warm leads and 1 paid pilot per cohort on average. We can provide the cohort roster and a short co-branded landing page.

Attachments: onramp_cohort_roster.csv (participant list), cohort-onepager.pdf (program overview)

Can you confirm if this is something Redwood can authorize? If helpful, we can structure it as a reimbursement/credit grant or issue a marketplace voucher.

Warmly,
Sara Jones
Head of Partnerships — OnRamp Partners
partners@onramp.io
https://onramp.io
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jones <sara@onramp.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OnRamp cohort support: promotional credit request

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the details and the cohort roster. This sounds aligned with our marketplace enablement program. Quick clarification questions before I route for approval: 

- Do you need all credits up-front or can we tranche (e.g., 50% at start, 50% after demo day)?
- Do any participants require extended retention or special compliance (e.g., EU data residency)?
- Are you asking for trial extensions per-team (extra 7 days) beyond our default 14-day trial?

Internal note to Marcus/Aditya/Vanessa: can we accommodate a 100k token pool tied to the OnRamp listing, with an option to carry unused credits forward into next cohort if less than 40% consumed? If carry-forward is problematic, a marketplace voucher model may be simpler.

As next steps: if Marcus can confirm budget/approval and Aditya can confirm fulfillment mechanism (voucher vs. direct credits), I’ll send Sara a formal mutual action plan and the voucher terms.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OnRamp cohort support: promotional credit request

Tessa —

Thanks for the summary. Budget-wise we can allocate up to 60k tokens from the marketplace promotion pool this quarter. I’m okay with a tranche approach: 30k up-front, 30k contingent on demo day metrics (active usage by at least 4 teams). Carry-forward into next cohort will need an exec exception; prefer voucher issuance tied to the OnRamp marketplace listing to keep accounting clean.

Vanessa — can your team draft the voucher terms and add a short MOP (metrics of performance) clause so we can trigger the second tranche automatically?

Marcus
Head of Growth Partnerships (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jones <sara@onramp.io>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OnRamp cohort support: promotional credit request

Sara —

Appreciate the patience here. Per Marcus, we’ll proceed with a voucher-based fulfillment: 30k tokens issued as vouchers on Sep 17 (to be claimed by participants), with a second 30k conditioned on the demo-day usage threshold (we’ll auto-issue if MOP met). I attached the draft trial agreement and the cohort roster for finance.

Notes on implementation:
- Voucher expiry: 90 days from issue.
- Trial extension: we can provide an optional +7 days for teams that request it via the voucher claim form.
- Accounting: finance will treat this as marketplace marketing expense; Marcus to confirm cost center.

Attachments: onramp-trial-agreement.pdf, onramp_cohort_roster.csv

I’ll loop in procurement for the voucher issuance next week and send a short MOP template. Thanks — excited to see this cohort.

—Aditya
Director, Growth Programs
Redwood Inference
